items.evidence: README's play command (--ticks 600 --seed 1 --inputs 1:enter,2:shoot,300:up,330:none --settings ...) printed one JSON object with tick, screen, menu_index, language, volume, difficulty, texts, score, best, coins, wave, gate_health, guard_y, quick, heavy, saved, enemies, bolts; --at 1 shows screen title.
--frame X.png --size 800x480 wrote PNGs whose header reads 800 x 480 (play, title, settings, shop, and the README frame command).

Fresh folder, tick 1: texts [Hold the gate: the long night, Best: 0, Start, Settings, Quit], saved false. 1:enter -> tick 2 screen play, wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate_health 10, first walker at x 20.
Settings: 4 rights volume 8->10 and stays 10; 14 lefts -> 0 and stays 0; language right en->es->fr then stays fr, left -> es; difficulty starts normal, rights -> hard (stays), lefts -> easy (stays).

With es and fr kept: title (Récord/Empezar/Continuar/Ajustes/Salir; Record/Commencer/...), settings, play (Puntos/Monedas/Oleada 1 de 8/Puerta; Score/Pièces/Vague 1 sur 8/Porte), shop (Tienda.../Boutique...), paused, lost, won all translated; es/fr string tables have exactly en's keys; only the game's name stays English.
Run 1 set volume 5, Spanish, Hard in folder k3; run 2 with k3 printed volume 5, language es, difficulty hard; a new folder printed 8, en, normal.
Holding up from tick 2: guard_y 6 -> 6.1 -> 7 at tick 12 (0.1/tick = 6 u/s), 12 at tick 62 and stays 12; holding down reaches 0 at tick 320 and stays 0.
Held shoot, nothing bought: bolt ages 67/43/19 (24 ticks apart), x grows 0.2333/tick (14 u/s); oldest bolt seen age 77 at x 19.97, never beyond x 20.
Seed 1: walkers enter at ticks 2, 92, 182, 272, 362 (90 ticks) in lanes 2,4,8,6,6, health 2, x drops 0.025/tick (1.5 u/s); no sixth enemy.
Guard at y 2.5 fires one bolt: lane-2 walker goes 2 -> 1 health and bolt gone; at y 2.7 the bolt passes (walker stays 2) and leaves the field. Second hit on a walker: score 0->10, coins 0->1.

--set gate=2: walker reaching x 0 at tick 892 removed, gate 2->1, score/coins unchanged; second at tick 982 -> screen lost, texts [The gate fell, Score: 10, Best: 10, Enter: title]. Also a natural Normal run lost on wave 3 after leaking.
Difficulty set to Easy then Start: gate_health 14 ('Gate: 14'); Hard then Start: 7.

Shop opens at wave 1's end (screen shop, enemies and bolts empty, Escape does nothing) with texts [Shop, Coins: 5, Next: wave 2 of 8, Quick hands: level 0 of 2, 5 coins, Heavy bolts: level 0 of 1, 12 coins, Mason: gate 10 of 10, full, Next wave]: Mason's price (4 coins) is not shown whenever the gate is full, which is the usual case after wave 1.

--set coins=30, bought Quick hands: 35->30 coins, quick 1, held shoot bolt ages 59/41/23/5 (18 apart); second purchase 30->20, quick 2, ages 69/57/45/33/21/9 (12 apart); third Enter: coins 20, quick 2 unchanged.
Heavy bought (35->23 coins, heavy 1); second Enter left coins 23; in wave 2 one bolt destroyed a 2-health walker (score 50->60, coins 23->24).

Gate 7, coins 12: Mason -> gate 10, coins 8. Gate 8, coins 13: Mason -> gate 10 (capped, not 11), coins 9; Enter again at full: unchanged. Gate 8, coins 3: Enter on Mason changes nothing. Gate 10 full with 8 coins: nothing.
Next wave entered at tick 514; first walker appears at tick 574 (60 later); texts 'Wave 2 of 8'; 7 walkers in wave 2 (count stays 7).
--set wave=3: 6 walkers then 4 runners, 72 ticks apart; runners health 1, x drops 0.05/tick (3 u/s); a runner shot down gave score 0->15, coins 0->1.
--set wave=4: 9th enemy is a brute, health 6, x drops 1/60 per tick; 6 hits destroy it: score 10->50, coins 1->4. In the 8-wave run a brute reaching the gate took it 62->59.
modules/work/waves.json holds per wave walkers, runners, brutes, every; lib.rs reads it via include_str; README 'How to change a wave' says to edit it.

Played waves 1-8 in one run (with the test option --set gate=150 so the gate stands; shooting lane 6): screen won at tick 12700, score 220 before + 20 x 59 gate = 1400 shown; Enter -> title showing Best: 1400.
Escape at 100: screen paused, enemies frozen (x 17.55/19.8 at ticks 101 and 150); Enter on Resume: play continues from the same x; Escape then Title -> title screen.
saved false during wave 1, true when shop opens; next run with the same folder: title texts [.., Start, Continue, Settings, Quit].
Bought Quick hands in the shop (coins 5->0) and stopped; next run Continue -> shop with wave 1, score 50, coins 0, gate 10, quick 1; Next wave -> 'Wave 2 of 8' play with first walker 60 ticks later.

Title from pause in wave 2 left Continue in a later run; Start then removed it (saved false, no Continue in the next run); a lost run (natural, wave 3) and the won run both end with saved false and no Continue afterwards.
Lost with 10 -> Best: 10 on lost screen and in a later run's title; a later lost run with 0 left Best: 10; won screen showed Best: 1400 and title after it Best: 1400.
Two runs seed 7, same script, each from its own copy of the same kept folder: outputs byte-identical. Wave-1 lanes seed 1 [2,4,8,6,6], seed 2 [4,8,4,2,8], seed 7 [10,6,2,2,4].

Frame at wave 8 tick 905: grey gate strip at x 0, blue guard at (2, 8.8), green walkers, small yellow runners, large red brute at (19.35, 6), three bolts at y 8.8 x 4.3/9.9/15.5, all at the state's positions (40 px a unit); HUD shows Score, Coins, Wave 8 of 8, Gate: 96.
Title frame in French with Continuer outlined (menu_index 1); settings frame in Spanish with Dificultad outlined (menu_index 2); shop frame with Heavy bolts outlined (menu_index 1).
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json, one per language, UI files reference keys; README 'How to add a language' says how.
README has How to play, where kept (settings.json in the --settings folder, kept.best / kept.save), and the play and frame commands, which ran as written.

defects: The shop's Mason line drops its price ('full') whenever the gate is at its starting health, though Mason is always 4 coins.
Escape while paused does not resume (stays paused), though actions.json calls it 'Pause and resume' and the code means it to.
menu_index prints 0 on the play screen, though README says it is null there.
'best' prints null at tick 0 (README admits it is set from tick 1).
In the settings frame the title's name shows through and over the edge of the settings panel (overlapping text).
On title and shop the Start / Next wave buttons are always filled blue (primary style), which can be mistaken for the chosen entry; the chosen one is marked only by an outline.
The full 8-wave win could only be reached here with the test option --set gate=N; README says the builder could not find an unaided win either.
